title: Sahir619/fable-method
claim: Sahir619/fable-method — The Fable Workflow: how Claude Fable 5 worked, distilled into skills any model can run, with the eval that keeps it hone
why_good: Not another prompt pack: four skills with explicit thresholds a mid-tier model can follow literally, plus an adversarial eval harness (15 rounds, 260+ runs) with the failures kept in the log — the eval discipline is rarer than the workflow.
value: 商业价值: the durable asset is the eval harness — proving your agent still works as models get swapped is a real budget line; the workflow is the marketing, the testing layer is the product.
risk: Tied to the mythos of a retired model, and methodology repos age in months; unless the eval harness becomes a hosted product this stays a well-executed content artifact, not a company.
hook: Fable Method has garnered 1,958 stars by simplifying Claude Fable 5's complex workflows into actionable skills for any model.

zh.claim: Fable Method通过将Claude Fable 5的复杂工作流程简化为任何模型可执行的可操作技能，获得了1,958个星标。
zh.hook: Fable Method通过简化Claude Fable 5的复杂工作流程，获得1,958个星标，提供任何模型可执行的技能。
zh.why_good: 不是又一个提示词合集：四个技能带明确阈值、中端模型也能照做，外加对抗性评测框架（15 轮、260+ 次运行）且失败记录全留档——这种评测纪律比工作流本身更稀缺。
zh.value: 商业价值：真正耐久的资产是评测框架——团队换模型时“证明 Agent 没退化”是实打实的预算；工作流负责传播，测试层才是能卖的产品。
zh.risk: 绑定在一个已退役模型的情怀上，方法论仓库几个月就过时；不把评测框架做成托管产品，它只是一件执行漂亮的内容作品，不是公司。

pick_reason: The project appears to be a methodology rather than a distinct product that can be monetized.
